ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Keyboard Layout Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the keyboard preload installation with a suspicious keyboard layout, e.g. Chinese, Iranian or Vietnamese layout load in user session on systems maintained by US staff only Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Keyboard\\ Layout\\\\Preload\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Keyboard\\ Layout\\\\Substitutes\\\\.*")) AND (Details = RGX(".*00000429.*") OR Details = RGX(".*00050429.*") OR Details = RGX(".*0000042a.*")))
